### findConflicts

```ts
findConflicts: (id, hotkey, recordedWith?) => AppHotkey<string, 
  | HotkeyChord
  | HotkeySequence
  | null>[];
```

Defined in: [app-hotkeys.ts:421](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/hotkeys/src/app-hotkeys.ts#L421)

Other app hotkeys that would collide if `id` used `hotkey`. Pass the
recorder's `context` for a recorded hotkey: it has the key press, which
also finds a hotkey written differently that the same press fires.

### setCustomHotkey

```ts
setCustomHotkey: (id, hotkey, recordedWith?) => AppHotkey<string, 
  | HotkeyChord
  | HotkeySequence
  | null>[];
```

Defined in: [app-hotkeys.ts:407](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/hotkeys/src/app-hotkeys.ts#L407)

Sets the user's hotkey for an app hotkey. `null` unbinds it.
Returns conflicting app hotkeys; when any exist, nothing changes. Pass
the recorder's `context` for a recorded hotkey, as for `findConflicts`.

#### Parameters

`string`

##### hotkey
